errors.description: Model failed to recognize that there were 5 distinct rolls, each producing 4 top-face colors, and instead treated the initial state as the only roll.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'The green color appears only once in the sequence.'

errors.description: Model correctly identified green appearing once in the initial frame but failed to count across all 5 rolls, ignoring the dynamic nature of the experiment.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'Therefore, the total number of times green was rolled is 1.'

errors.description: Model misidentified the color configuration of the cubes after the first roll, failing to track color changes over time.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'The colors of the cubes are: First cube: red, Second cube: white, Third cube: green, Fourth cube: yellow' — this is only true at the start, not across all rolls.

analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the temporal structure of the task. It treated the initial static frame as the entire event, ignoring the 5 sequential rolls explicitly described in the ground truth. This led to a gross undercount of green occurrences (1 vs. 7). The error cascades from misperceiving the dynamic nature of the video to failing to perform the required temporal aggregation. The model also incorrectly assumed the cube colors remained fixed, violating the explicit instruction to 'record the color on the top of each cube after each roll.'
